nom: Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester Brightening Serum

avis.titre: Please bring back your Vitamin C-Ester EYE SERUM!
avis.texte: I ordered the Vitamin C-Ester Brightneing Serum only because you no longer have my favorite which is the Vitamin C-Ester Brightening EYE SERUM. The Eye Serum was amazing and no other product you have works the same. Please bring back the Vitamin C-Ester Brightneing EYE SERUM! Thank you.
I have used this product for a week now. it looks like it brightens my face.
Very strong serum. Burned my eyes and I had a terrible reaction with redness, rash and dryness. Waiting to get my money back.
Great set! I'm 38. My skin is normal. Serum gives moisturizing, fast absorbing without sticky feeling, cream absolutely great! Consistence looks like something dense but in real it's like mousse.

I've been truing this for only one and a half weeks once a day. LOOK. I feel like nothing has decreased my acne scars until now. I looked at the other review pictures and decided to get it. Now I get to post my own😝 can't wait to update!

This product has changed my skin. I noticed a difference after one use, now after about 5 weeks everything has improved. I never thought a product would make me feel confident about my skin until I started using this
This is one of my favorite products I can't do without, my skin drinks it in. m My skin is so soft and has a much more even tone with daily use. I always have a backup!

I started using this stuff 6 months before my wedding to address my dark spots and dull lookin' skin. Within two months my skin was night and day! Even though it is on the pricier end, worth every penny!

avis.titre: Feel a difference on first application
avis.texte: My dermatologist recommended that I use vitamin C every day .. this product really is amazing

This is probably the first product I've seen noticeably smaller pores with so quickly, though, that's not what I bought it for. I am using this to hopefully fade acne scars, prevent wrinkles, and brighten my overall skin tone. So all that is still pending, but I've only used it a couple of days and pores are definitely smaller.
Love these 2 products. Both of them have lovely texture and absorb perfectly. It's hard to find good texture and absorption in either vitamin C or Spf cream. I love this duo

avis.titre: I do like this product, but their is one downside.
avis.texte: I purchased this product in the 2oz, I would say this serum is great, especially for the high content of vitamin C. But, when I apply this serum to my skin, it tends to not absorb very well and flake off my skin. I would say this product could improve, especially for the price. Maybe it's my skin and the way I apply it, but for me, it's just one downside, but overall it's a great product.

This Vitamin-C serum is milky and absorbs well. I have very oily skin and this product melts into my skin and does not feel greasy. It does have an orange smell that goes away quickly. It's expensive but worth it!

I normally don't write reviews, but I was so impressed with this serum. I have oily acne prone skin, so I use this after applying Perricone Acne Relief Toner. I found it to be light, not greasy at all. The scent is nice too. After a week my skin is noticeably smoother, and it has lightened older scars and dark spots. I'm excited to see so much progress this quickly.
I've been looking for a light serum for my oily skin and I think I found the one. Very light and I love how it brightens my skin. Wonderful product!

I have never reviewed any Perricone products although I have been a Perricone customer for many years and don't remember when I started using other products. I used several vitamin c products never worked what they promised and merely waste of money but Perricone vitamin c is a miracle. Everyone should have this product for routine skincare. I highly recommend this product and every penny is worth spent.

Results with this have been noticeable & fast! It's a lightweight serum, medium consistency and not runny. I can dot this onto my cheeks, chin and forehead and take my time in blending in to cover my face/neck, which is great as most serums tend to drip down and off my face before I've finished even dotting them on. I use it in the morning before applying moisturizer & SPF and it's definitely improved my skin tone - much clearer, brighter and my skin feels smoother too. I love how I can use this on my lips - BIG difference as lips have a pinkish tinge to them now, also can use around the eye area which I was worried it would be too strong for, but thankfully no irritation or eye sensitivity. Also no piling when used under makeup, and not oily whatsoever. Packaging is great too, simple dropper so I get the right amount of product and a non-oxidizing amber glass bottle. Yes it's a bit pricey, but totally worth it - not because it's a great Vit C serum (there are many other good ones out there too) but because I don't have to use a separate eye serum or lip product, I can use this for more or less all face areas and neck/decolletage too. -> My 'Ulta Beauty Top 7 must-have list' (My 7 favorite beauty products of all time, focusing mainly on my purchases at Ulta) < - < 1. Hair Loss Treatment: Divine Herbal Hair Oil < 2. Eye Cream: Clinique All about eyes < 3. Lip Gloss: Clarins Lip Comfort Oil < 4. Makeup Remover: Lancome Bi Facil < 5. Pigmentation + Anti-Aging Serum: Divine Herba
Don't buy if your African American with dark skin tone. It also has alcohol which dries out our skin.

avis.titre: As others have said - DO NOT use if you have acne prone skin
avis.texte: I finally had my acne under control and went to Ulta for some thing, a lady convinced me to buy this stuff… Immediately went from having zero pimples on my whole face for several weeks to at least 15! I was partially thinking it might be purging… But my skin was perfectly fine before hand so I'm not even going to wait for it to go away.

I tried many serums from past few years but I ended up with very bad breakouts the very next day of using those serums..BUT after I started using this serum it really started suiting on my skin......and I would highly recommend this product for sensitive skin !!!

avis.titre: I would not buy this again
avis.texte: Have seen little difference in my skin. Do not want to spend the money again to wait and see what it is like in a longer term
I really like the radiant look it gives, it's delicate yet effective as it reduces fine line and makes my skin glowing. I like the smell too
I've been using this vitamin c product for over 2 years along with deep crease serum and firming moisturizer.. this routine has my skin clean, clear and wrinkle free!
I have been using this for years, and I'll never stop. This has helped brighten my acne scars soooo much.
I have been using this serum for the past four years and I couldn't be happier with how my skin has responded. It is plump and smooth with diminishing discoloration. I highly recommend it!
I received a sample of this and the smell was overwhelming... Smoky like a barbecue pit. Was this a bad batch or does it all reek like this?

I've tried so many vitamin c serums and none of them have done a single thing for my skin. I was about to give up when someone recommended this one, and I thought why not. I am SO glad I took a chance because I'll never be without it now! it smells great, instantly absorbs, not sticky at all, layers well, and even out my skin so well, leaving me glowing! even my husband noticed how "radiantly skin is! great product and fair price point for the results you get.

I have been using this for the last couple of months and it has changed my skin yes it's a bit pricey but you only add a few drops in the morning and night. I have bad acne and this improved my face a lot

I have sensitive skin to begin with but I tried this product one time and immediately after applying a little to my face I felt it burning. Woke up the next morning to a red blotchy face. It got a little worse the next day. Retuned it right away.
Been using a short while but like how easy goes on, absorbs quickly

So I got this bc I heard Perricone was CCC was a dupe for Skinceuticals even though it's just a couple dollars off but I went to look at all their products and they had this for a huge discount so I got it. I left in my drawer for a week and decided to use it and wow wow wow made a huge difference in 3-4 days. I keep looking at their site and on here for another promotion which they do have but I'm going to wait a couple more days lol. I am going to get 2 more. I should've gotten 2-3 that day I ordered and so mad I didn't bc wow you will see a huge difference. This will help with hyperpigmentation and really fast at that. I didn't really see anything about fine lines but I think that one is the anime one not sure but this helps with dark spots. The best when it comes to that. I will get the other one after I'm finished with this and the 2 more I order. I can't wait! But if you have any acne marks, dark spots or any hyperpigmentation this will help asap!!!!!!!!! Did not get any free products for this review but I'm really impressed!

I still can't believe how effective this really is. So I read that the Perricone's Vitamin C with the Ferulic acid and vit E is kind of like Skinceuticals's so I kept looking at these products but I didn't want to waste money on that just yet so decided to get this vitamin c & at the best time ever (plz bring back the promotion). It sat in my drawer for a week cuz I didn't really think it'll be like what it details but I was like wait this is Vit C I need to use now cuz I didn't want it to go bad and WOW WOW WOW I promise you after the first 2 times I used it…. Allllll I mean alllll my dark spots faded!!!!!!!!! I had sooo much hyper pigmentation due to acne but & the reason I waited a wk was cuz I thought the vit C I was using before this was helping but at that rate it would've took a year what this one did in one week!!!!!!! I still can't believe it!! My face looks so much brighter. I was so embarrassed to go out with all these scars I recently got but now I don't even cover my face with anything. I get so excited to wash my face and put this on. I did not receive anything for this… I really wish I did lol cuz man the prices are high but if you have discoloration you need to try it. I'm still amazed. And sorry this post is so long and everywhere lol. But really try this…. It works fast!!!

avis.titre: This was a repurchase and it is my vitamin C of choice.
avis.texte: I use this everyday as part of my skincare routine. Of course I wish it wasn't so expensive but it is my vitamin C of choice and I like the product. I have repurchased it many times and I will continue to repurchase it and use it because I like the way my skin look.
This is a nice vitamin c serum. I use it every morning and it's really gentle. I have sensitive combo skin and it melts into my face. It lays a nice foundation for moisturizer to sit on top.

avis.titre: wow. this is the secret key to my skincare routine.
avis.texte: I suffer from eczema dry flakey skin and an oily forehead. i recently added this to my line of products and instantly saw results in 2-3 days. I'm telling y'all my skin tone has never been this even before. seriously. buy this! their products are pricey but this definitely is on the easier side.
after about 2 weeks of consistent use, i notice a dramatic difference!! my skin looked brighter and healthier! if you can afford to splurge, this is a great treat-yo-self

I have been using this product for about two weeks and it hit me this morning how much brighter my skin looks. And it's definitely softer. I've tried other Vitamin C products, and with the exception of Clinique which is simply to expensive to use all the time, this one is the only one I feel has really made a difference. The down side is I bought it as a Beauty Steal, so it will be a bigger hit to my wallet if I decide to purchase again.

Im 39 withcombination skin And I have been using it for about two weeks straight I love notice a much smoother complexion and much more even skin tone haven't noticed anything about minimizing pores as of yet. Im hopeful.

I'm 24 and I've had acne since I was 11. Luckily my acne scars are very minor. Besides this product helping the scars, it has done a great job managing my acne when added to my skincare routine. I've used this product for about 3 weeks. I'm noticing way less break outs, and when I do get an angry red pimple, the redness doesn't last near as long as normal. Even the brown spots that like to stick around for a while don't show up like they used to. My skin is soft and smooth when it used to be bumpy and oily. Definitely recommend!

I've only been using the serum for a week, but my skin looks better and feels so smooth! The product has a nice light texture unlike some others I've tried, and it absorbs quickly. Nice fragrance, too.

avis.titre: Only Vit C serum to work for me
avis.texte: This is the only Vit C serum that does not break me out. It is non oliy. It diminishes my pores and has a slight brightening affect.

Felt good at first few application but after using 10 days or so, my face felt like sand paper. The product is so "drying." After stopping using it, It took me another 10 days to get back to normal. This serum maybe good but not for everyone.
No change In my face after using for more than a month. I was very hopeful that it will reduce dark spots on my face but nothing happened

Pricy but I wanted to splurge on this because I really learned a lot from his book. Dr. Pericone Is a wealth of knowledge in his book regarding skin health. This is the first vit C serum that I feel like works. I am using proactive adapeline 0.1 at night and this during the day with cerave moisturizer as needed for dryness. I finally feel like I have good regimen, as my face is clearing up quickly and not as oily. My husband commented after just one week on my glow. I'm 38 with combo skin.

This has been a HUGE game changer for me. I have only been using this product for a month and see incredible changes. I have very uneven skin tone on my face as well as hyper pigmentation. Not only is my skin tone almost completely even, my hyper pigmentation is almost un noticeable. Not to mention the glow this has given my skin! I no longer wear foundation because of this product.
This serum is a bit sticky,.. and not for me. I really didn't notice a difference in my skin. I will stick with Mario Badescu for a fraction of the cost.

I bought this line (brightening) along with the Cold Plasma when there was a sale going on. I was not impressed with either. While this one does not break me out like the other, I'm not seeing any benefits and it's been a few months now. I will say a little bit goes a long way. The part that is annoying is I don't want to waste this, so while I would like to move onto another brand to help my skincare issues (35 years old, face looks dull and fine lines - so brightening and anti-aging), I cannot justify not using this since it's not technically hurting my face. I would like it to run out already so I can try another brand. lol I pretty much wasted a lot of money on Perricone MD products. Not impressed at all, and side note, I am a product junkie, so I have ample experience judging results from products from drug store brands to the prestige brands to pricy department store brands.

I keep a very thorough skincare regimen and only introduce new products in one at a time to ensure I know what the culprit is if something goes wrong. I started using this serum instead of my usual collagen serum and let me tell you - huge mistake! After only two days I got red splotchy spots all over my face and it itches like crazy! I even used sunscreen after applying it like recommended and clearly that didn't help. Couldn't even sleep because my face was so itchy. Never using this product again.

Works! My breakouts only tend to last a few days, but the marks and redness can hang around for 1-2 weeks (sometimes a month depending on the area) and it's so frustrating. I started using this serum 3 days ago and can see a noticeable difference and my skin tone is more even. I also used this in conjunction with the moisturizer with SPF during the day.
Love this stuff! Saw a huge difference in my face. My face looks brighter, healthy and glowy.😍pricy but worth it in my opinion

Although this product is pricy, I jumped out on the limb and bought it as I wanted to try it out. I'm getting ready for a wedding in November and want to step up my skincare game. This is the best my skin has ever experienced! It's so brightening, light, healthy, and smells amazing. I would 10/10 recommend!!
I have purchased this Brightening Serum 3 times, and will continue to do so! In addition to leaving your skin soft and smooth, it smells absolutely wonderful!
I use this along with the matching face wash & moisturizer and I have seen a dramatic decrease with my dark spots / scaring on my cheeks. It feels amazing and has a light citrus smell.

avis.titre: I am a die-hard fan of this product!
avis.texte: I tried this on a lark after it was recommended to me. I was told that it did a great job of breaking up melasma and dark spots. ABSOLUTELY TRUE for me! I actually like the smell and use it religiously every morning on my face, as well as the back of my hands for age spots. This serum definitely makes a difference for me. I now have no desire to try any other Vitamin C serum, this is THE one!

avis.titre: Finished the whole bottle & on to number 2!
avis.texte: I have dry to combination skin & it has never looked better! Evened out skin tone and have a natural glow to my skin that people constantly comment on! 100% recommend to try it out!

So I purchased this to have a serum to go with my daily face wash routine and baby, this stuff is amazing! I was kind of nervous about buying it due to the fact that I have sensitive skin and was going through a mild break out that I had from using another product and didn't want to make it worst but this has been everything! I've been using it for a week now and I already see some differences in my dark marks. The only thing I hate about this product is the price! I lucked up and got it half off but the regular price is really expensive but unfortunately I'll be buying it again 😩

avis.titre: My New Can't Live Without Daily Habit
avis.texte: This stuff works . I actually get a little stressed when I suddenly run out and realize it may be a few days for my next purchase . It brightens my face . The light - very light- citrusy , clean scent is a welcome experience as I apply it . My skin is noticeably brighter . First time I used it , it took about 4 weeks ish to see results ... but now I maintain it and love it . It's not a splurge but a necessity as part of my regime .

I have tried madd hippie, Cerave, and the ordinary vitamin C serums. I always want to go back to this one! You will see results fast but if you discontinue you will also notice a difference. I hate that it's a little pricy but it works amazing and I'd recommend it to anyone.
I purchased when on sale. I enjoy the feel of my skin when I apply this serum. I use in the morning after freshly washed skin. The serum sinks in quickly.

This product will not change your skin overnight. It takes consistent use but the results are absolutely worth it. I use it (mostly) in the morning and night. In the winter I won't use toner and I'll go straight to this. Both myself and my partner have benefited from this amazing serum. It is kind of pricey which has made me think of reconsidering this product. Other products I use: vitamin c face wash, and spf moisturizer by perricone I have sensitive skin^ and tend to break out along my jawline. This product actually helped clear any lingering blackheads!

avis.titre: I stocked up big time on this product
avis.texte: Finally something that gave me some visible results on stubborn spots. Overall brighten my face, like washing off grime. Half way through my first bottle, I could see my dark spots and blotchiness were lighter and my complexion looked "cleaner" and was smoother. I have used very expensive products and they never worked. This is silky-matte in texture, smells divine, and doesn't irritate or dry my skin. When it went on sale, I bought 4 more bottles to stock up. I use right after cleansing, 4-5 drops at night and 3-4 drops in the morning mixed with my hydrating face mist. I feel beautiful and don't have to put on the concealer soon as I wake up in order to hide my hyperpigmentation. Love it.

I would like to start out by saying last year cancer and I had a huge fight, needless to say I beat it. But....with 6 and a half months of chemotherapy and 6and a half weeks of radiation it took a lot out of me. Fortunately, I'm a Perricone women and have been off and on for around 20 years, I'm 59 now. So, I knew where to go to get my skin back on track, Perricone! The C line works wonders for my skin, I simply glow. You would never know I had cancer, my skin is beautiful. I'll never use anything else. Dr. Perricones products made my skin happy again. Also, I enjoy all the free gifts, I share them with my friends.

avis.titre: AMAZING!!! This REALLY made my other products soak in deeper
avis.texte: Very easy to use, smells great and helps moisturizers soak deeper into your skin!

I have been using this for a month. I haven't noticed a difference but maybe it's too soon. It doesn't smell good but it doesn't smell bad either. Once it dries I can't smell. Also the Vitamin C Esther moisturizing sunscreen smells fine and I put that on after this.
The product is great but it came with broken top and without samples I requested.

This serum is like a magic formula for my skin. I have adult acne and it is the only thing that clears it and brightens my skin at the same time. It is my MVP among all my beauty products. It also smells good, unlike other serums I've tried.

avis.titre: This cleared my mild adult acne!
avis.texte: I use this twice a day, after cleansing and toning. It's a silky thin cream that sinks in right away. I didn't get any redness like I have experienced with many other vitamin C based treatments. My mild acne cleared up right away and now I don't get any new spots. I'm guessing the exfoliation is clearing the pores? I highly recommend trying this treatment if you have had issues with other Vitamin C treatments.
I use this every morning and night and have been able to tell the biggest difference in the brightness and evenness of color in my face!! I absolutely love it
This product feels like it smoothes my face almost instantly. My face feels and looks tighter, in a good way, as soon as I put it on.

Every other serum I've used gives me tiny bumps, not huge breakouts , just annoying little bumps. This serum is perfect, no bumps, skin feels softer, looks brighter. Only downside is that price tag for such a tiny bottle . Ouch

I really was pleasantly surprised at how much I liked this. Knowing Dr. Perricone's youth-inspired work made me skeptical when I saw it at Ulta. This product is definitely worth it. The scent is very fresh and after 2 weeks of use, I can see a brightness to my skin.

avis.titre: Do not use if your skin is sensitive or acne prone
avis.texte: Bought this during Ulta's 21 days of beauty and super thankful I didn't pay full price. It made my face explode with bumps and pimples. My face felt so irritated. I decided to try it one more day and will never use again. I typically take reviews from folks with acne with a grain of salt. Often times people treating acne mix AHA/BHA products with this serum and have a reaction. That was not my case, I made sure it wasn't mixed with salicylic/benzoyl peroxide because I knew they wouldn't mix well. Still had a terrible reaction. Don't use if you've got super sensitive or acne prone skin with active breakouts!
This is a terrific product. I have used it for 2 years. It smooths and softens skin. I use it day and night. It has made such a difference in my skin's clarity and smoothness.

I absolutely LOVE this serum! It made my skin feel wonderful - so soft and smooth - and it smells FANTASTIC! It is a fresh citrus/rosemary scent. It absorbed quickly into my skin and I felt like it brightened my complexion. Not greasy at all. It is actually quite thin, so be careful not to waste any! It is pricey, so I tried a different serum after I ran out, but I'm BACK because the other serum didn't compare. My only complaint, I seemed to go through it quicker than I thought I would. I'm going to use it more sparingly this time.

I love this product. Ever since I started using it, I've noticed my skin has been a LOT brighter and smoother. My pores don't seem as big anymore. (Not sure if that's something it helps with, but it did!) Only downside is the smell. Kind of smells like orange medicine??
I bought serum 2 weeks ago, I can tell you it's changes my life.

avis.titre: Red bumps not working for me
avis.texte: I love the scent of this product being very ginger and earthy and I don't have sensitive skin, but this product after 2 days I started getting small red bumps all over my face and neck. I stopped using and bumps went away. I tried one more time on my upper chest skin and got same red bumps. I would not reccomend this product if you have sensitive skin, or even dry skin. I have normal skin and never had issues until I tried this product. Once I stopped I was fine??

I use this product every morning. I apply it before I apply my cold plasma. I honestly can say my skin is a even tone thanks to the daily application of this product. I can't reall say anything negative about it. I have found to get the best results, you must remain constant with your application. It will work if you preserve. Thank you Dr Perricone for helping me maintain a youthful look and even tone!

avis.titre: Do not buy if you have acne prone skin!
avis.texte: I have been using this product along with the moisturizer for about a month now and have noticed break outs for the last 3 weeks. The acne isn't a pimple, but red, raised bumps that itch more like hives. Reading online I found that Vit. C serum can do this, especially when Ferulic acid is one of the ingredients which it is. I have not used it for a day now and already the bumps/acne are disappearing. Phew!!
I received this product in a beauty box and I absolutely love it! My face is brighter, it goes on so smooth without irritating my skin and it smells wonderful I will buy this product again and again
i use only three time then my face red and itch and some acne on my face

avis.titre: Did not due what it was advertised to do
avis.texte: Although this product does smell nice and goes on smoothly, it did nothing for my age spot that I was combatting. It is expensive for a Brightening Serum and did not work for me. Used it faithfully for two months.

I love how it feels on my skin! It's amazing. I like how it brightened my sun spot on my face. It really works. the citrusy smelll isn't so great but it doesn't last long. This product was complimentary courtesy of Influenster. Thanks to Influenster I got to sample this product for free!

I was really happy that this serum didn't feel heavy, and it soaked into my skin quickly. The orange smell is energizing and fresh. I noticing quite a bit of improvement in the evenness of my skin-tone (which had begun to be bad enough that I was feeling bad about my skin). When I run out I will be buying some. I received this product free in exchange for an honest review.
My skin is much brighter and no harsh smell or reaction JUST BRIGHTER SKIN. I also noticed my skin isn't so oily now since I've been using this . Normally at 10am I'm a greasy mess

I'm 55 years old and I have normal skin with some lines and wrinkles. Not many. I also have a sun spot that I have been battling. I like to use this product at once a day along with my moisturizer. While this has brightened my skin, I am still at war with my sun spot. I was hoping this would lighten it, but it has not. I have used other PerriconeMD products and have been very pleased. I received this product for free for testing and to review.

This vitamin C serum ticks all of my serum boxes, as it brightens, smooths, and evens out my skin, while diminishing the appearance of dark spots from sun exposure. I didn't want to love this product, mostly due to its price tag, but I really, really do. It's now a staple in my evening skin care routine and I'm a die hard fan.

From the moment I first used the brightening serum, it left my skin feeling soft and smooth. I love that they've taken the care to create such a highly stable product. It feels good knowing that I'm applying such a high quality serum to start and end the day. It has a nice light citrus scent that reminds me of baby aspirin. Smells very nice. I would purchase this product and also would like to try other products in the line as well. I received this complimentary product for testing purposes. I give it an A rating!
This Vitamin C brightening serum is great! It has a great scent and feels super refreshing. I felt it tightening. Will be buying more of this for sure!

avis.titre: Love how it makes my face look and feel
avis.texte: I have brown spots and wanted to try the skin brightening Serum. It seems to me that my face overall looks hydrated and the brown spots seem lighter. They are still there but I will continue using the serum to see how much brighter they can get.I received this product as a free sample for testing purposes.

I did not expect much from this product at first, as I do not have any dark circles, but I am here to tell you it does soo much more than brighten eyes! I started using it and after about 2 weeks I noticed a big difference in the skin around my eyes it had really smoothed the skin and it did not feel crepe-y! I am now using it around the corners of my lips also! And the smell os amazing - so fresh! I received Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester Brightening Serum for review from influenster but I will be adding this to my Christmas wishlist!

avis.titre: Great product to maintain improvement of my melasma!
avis.texte: This is an excellent serum...a great addition to my skincare regimen. I am currently using a prescription product from my dermatologist to treat my melasma and sunspots, and this serum will be a great product to maintain my skin's appearance going forward. The serum feels great on my skin, has a nice rosemary fragrance, and a little goes a long way. A 30ml bottle will last quite a while. I was very happy to receive my 1st bottle complimentary for testing purposes, and will definitely be buying again!

I use this every morning and night. A little goes a long way. And my dark circles are lightening alot. The only thing I hate is the price . As a single mom this is something that I would have to save for if I want to continue to use it.

I like this product but I didn't love it. I have oily combination skin and yet if I used it daily it dried my skin out. Maybe I should have only used every other day. I received the product free from Influenster for testing. The bottle lasts a long time despite being small.

Perricone MD Brightening Serum I have been using this in the morning and at night after I cleanse my face. After applying the serum and it absorbs then I always apply my moisturizer. I have light colored skin with freckles. I noticed some lightening of my skin and also the circles under my eyes. The serum is light weight and a white in color. It smells very citrusy. I received this product for testing purposes.

I received this free for testing purposes however, I will be purchasing it on my own. I have had a rather large age spot on my forehead for years and have tried several products to get rid of it. I'd pretty much given up when I got this product. It's very light and smells a little like orange. You get an instant smoothing result. It doesn't mess with my makeup either. After two weeks I noticed some fading and after a month it's helped a lot. Extremely happy with this product.

I started using this almost a month ago. It is lightweight, smells fresh and absorbs quickly. It leaves my face feeling soft and smooth. I have noticed my texture has smoothed out, my skin is brighter, fine lines have smoothed some and my dark spots have lightened up. I have also noticed the redness has gotten better! I am sure with continued use the difference would be even more dramatic. I received these products complimentary from Influenster for testing purposes.

I love the formula and smell of it. It's not greasy at all, which is great after running into so many that are. After the first use, I could telling it was working like it should. Only downside is that I have eczema and need to not use this product on that area of my face.

I absolutely adore this serum! The texture is beautiful and sinks quickly into my skin leaving it feeling hydrated and moisturized. I've definitely noticed that my skin looks brighter and more youthful after a few weeks! I received this product free from Influenster for testing purposes; all opinions are my own. Would highly recommend!

Wow! This brightening serum is no joke. The serum itself is a milky white color and has a herbal/medicinal scent to it that disappears as it soaks into your skin. The instructions on the back of the box say to apply to a clean face in an upward motion before you apply your moisturizer and that it can be used in the morning and evening. I found that wearing it under my moisturizer that had an spf made my skin feel rough so I personally chose to apply it only in the evenings when I was not wearing sunscreen. I noticed my skin definitely got brighter and looked more youthful over a 30 day period of use. I did receive this product for free to review and the above opinion and experience are mine and truthful.

avis.titre: My skin says "aaah"  every morning that I put it on!
avis.texte: This is a stellar serum that moisturizes and soothes the face and neckline. I have used this product for about 10 years and other ladies are surprised when I tell them my age of 66 years.

I am sold on this product. I received a free trial from Influenster and I'm so thankful! My skin color is very uneven with age spots and sun damage. This is the only product that has made a difference in the way my skin looks and feels.

I have been using this product once or twice a day for many weeks now. It is a thin milky serum with a pleasant citrus scent. I feel it made my skin smooth and healthy. I didn't feel it helped reduce spots or even out tone. This product does contain great ingredients that I know are beneficial for my skin. I received this product complementary for reviewing purposes.

The lightweight feel of this serum made me very happy. I was able to use it under my makeup during the day without it muddling with other products. It absorbs quickly. Over my 35 day use so far my skin has felt softer and looks more resilient. Overall fresh looking skin has developed for me as I struggle with dull complexion. * I recieved this product complimentary for testing purposes.

I don't really use serums often because I do have issues sometimes with breakouts and oily skin. I am 43 wuth some fine lines and wrinkles and very combo skin with slight redness on cheeks. But...this serum leaves my skin feeling refreshed and clean versus sticky or tacky. I don't notice oiliness but a fresh, vibrant look, hence the term brightening. I noticed a difference upon first use. I have been using this for a month now, and I still have half a bottle. My skin looks healthier and brighter! The scent is wonderful also, and a little does go a long way. That said, the price is the only reason I don't give this 5 stars. I would like to keep using it, but I haven't to really consider cost. I did get this as part of the Influenster review, but this in no way shapes my beliefs about the product.

This is a very lightweight product. It smells good and does make my skin feel soft and nit greasy. It didn't work for me on a dark spot on my face, wrinkles or dark circles unfortunately. I received a bottle complimentary for testing purposes #influenster

This is so lightweight and my skin soaked it up instantly. Doesn't feel sticky or leave a residue behind. I have always struggled with dark circles and didn't think I would find anything that would help but this product has shown me the light. I can see that the under eye area has brightened & even see a change in the pigmentation of the skin. Where it used to be a grayish tone now looks a light blush hue. That blew me away. My pores are also a concern for me, and since I began using this, I have definitely noticed an improvement. I will continue to use this product and repurchase. I was sent this absolutely complimentary for reviewing purposes.
In.a few days I can already see the difference in my skin's texture.

I received this for free from Influenster and have been using it for about 3 weeks. It has really rejuvenated my skin and smoothed it out! I haven't noticed any lightening of my sunspots but I plan to keep using it to see. My skin gets irritated easily and this doesn't bother it at all. It smells really nice and feels great. I want to try it with the Vit C 15 Serum.

I really like this product. You don't need a lot, just a little bit goes a long way. I definitely noticed that my face looks brighter and feels more supple after using this product. I have been using it underneath a thicker moisturizer. And I have definitely noticed a difference in my skin.

I have been trying this product for about a month. I received it free from Influenster to try and give my honest opinion on. I was impressed with the fact that it was not drying or irritating to my sensitive skin. The smell is pretty intense and smells like medicine. However, it does subsidize very quickly. I think you might have to use it longer to really notice major changes. I think it improved the texture of my skin and probably did make it look a bit healthier. It seems like it does take a lot of it to get results though. It would probably be better with the entire line of products.

I have dark sports and freckles so my face never looks so great . Been using this for a month now and noticed a good change. My face looks clearer as the dark spots are getting lighter. I got this free for testing but will be buying more!

avis.titre: Improvement in some areas not in others.
avis.texte: I got this product free to test and have been using it for about a month 2x a day. I love the rosemary cittus scent and it's made a noticeable difference in my skin tone and smoothness. No noticeable difference in fine lines and now my freckles stand out against my now paler even skin. The other qualities are making me consider purchasing it, since yhe price drop. I used to think serums were just high priced versions of moisturizers. It made a believer out of me.

"Beautiful, Glowing Skin", that's what I keep hearing from coworkers at my school...your skin is really Glowing. I've told them all about this serum and how smooth and nice my skin feels now. I feel like I actually have beautiful skin, I even use it on my neck and wow! Thank you for such a great product, my hubby and I changed to a healthy lifestyle with good and exercise at the first of June and have lost a combined 60lbs, now I feel as though my skin looks and feels as good as the rest of my body! Can't wait to try more things from your line! I did receive this product complimentary for testing purposes and these are my opinions.

avis.titre: This is my new Holy Grail skincare item!
avis.texte: I'm so pleasantly surprised by how well Vitamin C Ester Brightening Serum worked for me! The first thing I noticed was the amazing orange scent! And my skin was so soft and after about a week or so some of my discoloration spots were fading. I'm so thankful that I received this complimentary for testing purposes and I will definitely continue buying this Holy Grail item in the near future.

avis.titre: I love this as soon as it's gone Im buying it again
avis.texte: I love this serum its not greasy it smells good and it is gentle on my skin i also love the fact that it lightned up my age spots...not drastically but subtle i was so suprised i did not break out. With this product i recieved this product for free for testing purposes

This is my first time using any product from the Perricone MD line. I received a complimentary bottle of this serum for testing purposes. After using for about 3 weeks, I do notice a difference! My skin is softer, and the dark spots on my face have lightened quite a bit. It does have a somewhat strong 'medicinal' or herbal scent, but it does not last very long after application. I like how it goes on smooth, absorbs quickly, and does not leave a residue.

I recieved this serum complementary from Influenster. Have been using the serum for 3 weeks and OMG!!!!! My skin looks amazing already, it is bright snd looks super healthy. I love the fact that the serum is creamy and doesn't leave a sticky feel on my skin. I use it firsy thing in the morning after cleansing. Another bonus is that there is no irritation on my skin, i've tried many vit C serums and some have done nothing and some others irritated my skin. Will never be without it. I you want you skin to look bright, soft , supple and you also want anti-aging benefits, you NEED this serum ad part of you skincare regimen.

I'm only giving it 4 stars because of the price tag. This absorbs into your skin quickly and doesn't leave a greasy residue. After 2 weeks I noticed the redness on my cheeks is almost gone, and the dark spots around my hairline are gone. I'm absolutely going to purchase this when this runs out. I got this free in exchange for a review.

I received this product for free from Influenster to try and review all opinions are my own. I've use this product for four weeks and have definitely seen frightening and definite smoother skin. I enjoy putting this on my face as it is very lightweight and has a light refreshing citrusy smell.
